problem_restatement.observed_problem: Concurrent report-only public-info collectors intermittently exhausted the shared HTTP retry budget.
visible_effects: The BTC exact-mark watcher accumulated repeated http_429_retry_exhausted cycles.
The ETH lifecycle watcher accumulated repeated http_429_retry_exhausted cycles and became stale.
The HIP-3 roster was transiently unavailable on TUI Screen 4.
The continuous improvement report failed closed while required lifecycle evidence was stale.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Reduce optional BTC mark request load while preserving the frozen 120-second maximum mark-gap contract and leaving the live backend unchanged.

report_only_processes: The V58 multi-asset observer polls eight symbols and ten provider-symbol routes.
The MU, SP500, and SPCX pressure observers separately retain five-second public L2 collection for their causal pre-close contracts.
The original BTC mark watcher polled public mark data every three seconds.

residual_risks: The bounded zero-error window is short and does not prove future HTTP 429 elimination.
The intermediate 15-second process still observed two HTTP 429 events after its initial clean window.
A status and its exact side-reconciliation sidecar can transiently belong to different refresh generations; the continuous report fails closed and later recovers after the sidecar catches up.
The public venue preflight can remain stale during retry exhaustion even while the live checkpoint and venue stops remain healthy.
No BTC sweep entry occurred, so an entered lifecycle has not yet falsified or confirmed the 120-second mark-path requirement.

interpretation.technical_conclusion: The optional BTC watcher request rate was reduced by 90 percent and all required report statuses recovered during the bounded acceptance window.
interpretation.economic_conclusion: No profitability or strategy conclusion follows from this operational mitigation.

falsifiers: The current BTC watcher exits or stops refreshing its status.
A new sequence of HTTP 429 events makes required lifecycle statuses older than their 300-second fail-closed limit.
An entered BTC sweep lifecycle contains a mark observation gap above 120000 milliseconds.
The HIP-3 roster remains unavailable across multiple 120-second roster cycles.
The live backend process identity, V58 configuration fingerprint, orders, positions, or execution behavior changes as a result of this report-only mitigation.
next_step: Continue the 30-second BTC mark collection, alert on the first new retry-exhaustion burst or mark-gap breach, and keep the SP500 open-lifecycle exit reconciliation as the highest-value capital investigation.
